tenderSchedule.title: supply of NURSERY SCHOOL KIT Uniform, Shoes, Stationery & Textbooks for boys and girl students studying in Karnataka Moulana Azad Public Schools of Minority welfare department for the year-2026-27
tenderSchedule.description: The Directorate of Minorities, Bengaluru hereby invites tender in two cover system Technical and Commercial Bids from the registered and eligible manufacturing companies/authorized distributors/Development Corporations for supply NURSERY SCHOOL KIT Uniform, Shoes, Stationery & Textbooks for the students studying in Karnataka Moulana Azad Public Schools of Minority welfare department for the year-2026-27 through KPPP PORTAL, prospective manufacturers/authorized suppliers or distributors willing to participate in this tender shall necessarily register themselves with above mentioned KPPP PORTAL

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Directorate of Minorities, Maulana Abul Kalam Aazad Bhavan, No.16 C, Millers Tank Bed Area, Vasanth Nagar, Bangalore-560 052.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions related to eligibility, as specified in the tender document, shall be applicable.
